evals.name: sr-fully-compliant
evals.prompt: The article page https://example.com/blog/building-a-backlink-checker is about to ship to production. Run the SEO pre-flight gate on it. The preview server-side HTML is in evals/files/eval-0/page.html, the site sitemap is in evals/files/eval-0/sitemap.xml, an internal listing page is in evals/files/eval-0/index.html, and context about the page (sibling translations, HTTP status) is in evals/files/eval-0/context.md. Produce a full gate report with PASS/FAIL verdict per check, concrete evidence, and fix suggestions for any FAIL.
evals.expected_output: A gate report showing all applicable checks PASS, overall verdict PASS, with concrete evidence quoted from the HTML.
assertions: The report states an overall verdict of PASS for this fully compliant page
The report produces a verdict for every applicable check (HTTP status, canonical, robots, server-side content, sitemap, internal links)
Check 4 (server-side content) is marked PASS with evidence that the title, single H1, and body text are present in the raw server HTML
The report does not falsely flag a problem on a clean page
The output quotes concrete evidence (e.g. an actual tag or URL) rather than only vague statements
The report has seven numbered sections in order 1 to 7
Each of the seven sections contains a Verdict, Evidence, and Fix field
Check 5 (hreflang) is explicitly marked N/A (does not apply) for this single-language page, not PASS and not omitted
The overall Verdict is stated as exactly PASS (not a synonym like 'ready to ship' or 'no issues')

evals.name: client-only-heading
evals.prompt: The landing page https://example.com/tools/backlink-analyzer is about to ship to production. Run the SEO pre-flight gate on it. Produce a full gate report with PASS/FAIL verdict per check, concrete evidence, and fix suggestions for any FAIL.
evals.expected_output: A gate report that FLAGS a problem with server-side content — the H1 is only present after client-side rendering, so check #4 must FAIL.
assertions: Check 4 (server-side content) is flagged FAIL, not PASS
The report states the H1 is absent from the raw server HTML or only present client-side
The report gives an overall verdict of FAIL (the page should not ship as-is)
The report explains the risk that an H1 present only in client-side JS may not be seen by a crawler
The report includes a concrete fix (e.g. server-render the H1 and body into the HTML)
The report has seven numbered sections in order 1 to 7
Each of the seven sections contains a Verdict, Evidence, and Fix field
The overall Verdict is stated as exactly FAIL
